answer: An agent marketplace requires every identity to lock a $100 bond for 30 days before receiving one daily job slot. Agents selling sparrow counts, comet forecasts, or orchard advice face the same rule. Creating extra names yields no free capacity: an attacker seeking 1,000 daily slots must immobilize $100,000 for a month. The bond makes a swarm costly in proportion to its capacity, though a wealthy attacker can still fund one.
